scope: Exact source-import closure, not repository-root Lake build or Yang-Mills theorem
static_target_scan: No sorry, admit, custom axiom, unsafe, partial, or native_decide declarations/calls found after comment removal

semantic_scope.carrier: Full real matrix algebra and its native WithLp 2 double; abstract bounded operators on real Hilbert spaces
semantic_scope.positive_adjoint: Derived from the Hilbert-Schmidt pairing; not assumed equal to a Krein adjoint
semantic_scope.nonzero_tests: Nonzero coefficients give nonzero doubled boundaries; their positive adjoint differs from the unexchanged boundary
semantic_scope.coercivity_hypotheses: Actual homotopy equation and explicit norm/pointwise bound; no constructed interacting family or uniform-in-stage bound
semantic_scope.colimit: Existing Cl11TensorTowerLimit and native ofStage/bonding/universal maps
semantic_scope.uniform_descent: Conditional trace-form bound on a cofinal tail; exact coefficient compatibility describes fixed limit elements, not growing interactions
semantic_scope.state_tests: Real linear functional invariance and odd readouts; positivity, equilibrium, extremality and spontaneous phase breaking are not inferred
semantic_scope.hestenes_krein_owners: Unchanged; no replacement analyticity, complexification, or analytic completion
semantic_scope.physical_claims: No spectral reconstruction, physical vacuum identification, or Yang-Mills mass-gap theorem

publication_note: Any later documentation-only commit preserves all checked Lean source bytes.
